items.question: How does the AI work?
items.answer: Our AI analyzes your business data to automate tasks like attendance verification, payroll calculation, and anomaly detection. It learns from your patterns to provide better recommendations over time.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Yes. We use end-to-end encryption, and our servers are located in Indonesia in compliance with local regulations. We're ISO 27001 certified.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Most businesses are up and running in under 30 minutes. For data migration from existing systems, our team typically completes it in 1-3 business days.

items.question: Can I integrate with existing systems?
items.answer: Yes. Professional and Enterprise plans include API access and we support integrations with popular accounting software, e-commerce platforms, and more.

items.question: What if I want to cancel?
items.answer: You can cancel anytime. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee, and your data can be exported in standard formats.
